column1: # Who reads the newly-active edge word at object+0xE4C. Cycle 1361.
# HOW THE POPULATION WAS NARROWED. Fourteen functions touch displacement 3660 on
# a non-stack base -- the displacement collision again. The discriminator is that
# a genuine reader must reach the SAME object 0x82211DF8 writes, which is
# functions build exactly that address with exactly that arithmetic.
# EACH TESTS A SINGLE BIT, with `rlwinm rX,rX,0,N,N`, which keeps PPC bit N and
# therefore slot 31-N.
# columns: function object slot_bits
# So the four objects are NOT interchangeable: different subsystems read
# different ones, and each cares about a handful of named slots.
# WHAT THIS MAKES THE CHAIN. device snapshot -> record -> per-binding deadzone and
# scale -> active-slot mask -> edges and auto-repeat -> per-slot action. That is
# an INPUT COMMAND system: "slot 5 was just pressed, do this", with auto-repeat
# for held slots.
# AND THAT IS NOT THE FLIGHT CONTROLLER. Cycle 1358 established the float on this
# path drives auto-repeat rather than integration; this cycle finds its consumers
# testing single slot bits to trigger discrete actions. Nothing on this tick
# integrates a position or an orientation.
# NOT ESTABLISHED: what the three consumers do with their bits; what the first two
# objects (context+0x2458C and +0x256F0) are read by; whether the analogue values
# the binding layer produces are consumed anywhere on this tick at all -- the
# three consumers found here read only the EDGE word, not the value arrays.
